age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years. The minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01/07/2026. Age relaxations allowed as per rules: For S.C's, S.T's & BC's 5 (Five) years; For ex-service man 3 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces; Disable persons 10 (ten) years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification | ayush medical officer: Must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship. | pharmacist: i) Must possess any of the following qualifications: a. D Pharmacy, b. B Pharmacy, c. Pharma.D ii) Must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council | multi purpose worker (mpw): i) Must have passed VII Class examination. ii) Must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle. | psychosocial counselor: Must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission. | yoga professional: i) Must possess a Degree in Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship. ii) Must possess a Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government.

how_to_apply: Download the application form along with instructions from the official website of the District Collector's Office, Jangaon District.
Fill in the downloaded application form and duly enclose the required copies of certificates.
Submit the filled application form in person or through registered post to O/o. DM&HO, 1ST Floor, Collectorate, Jangaon District.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 24.10.2026 by 5.00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications which are received after due dates will be summarily rejected, and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. Candidate is allowed to Exam along with any Valid Identity Proof and Black/Blue Ball Point Pen and exam pad Only. Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained in Written Exam and displayed on website for transparency.

faq.question: Q1. What is DET Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DET Jangaon Recruitment 2026 is an official notification issued by the Government of Telangana, Department of Employment and Training, Jangaon District to engage 8 contract vacancies for AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, Yoga Professional, and Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) posts under National AYUSH Mission.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available across 5 categories of services in Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 24.10.2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government with one year compulsory internship.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01/07/2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Filled-in applications along with self-attested copies of required certificates must be submitted in person or through registered post to O/o. DM&HO, 1ST Floor, Collectorate, Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to the marks obtained in a Written Exam.

faq.question: Q9. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The written examination will be conducted on 25.10.2026 at 11.00 AM at the Main Conference Hall, IDOC Complex, Collectorate, Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract term?
faq.answer: The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 and thereafter the services will be as per the need and also subject to satisfactory performance.
